To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting, pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, 5 U.S.C. § 552, copies of any records in the custody or control of the Central Intelligence Agency concerning: 

Full name: Raymond Charles Horsch
Also spelled Hörsch or Hoersch. Typically he went by Ray Horsch or R.C. Horsch.
Aliases: 
Benjamin Harris
Richard Harris
Stanley E. Stokowski 
S. E. Stokowski 
Date of Birth: May 5, 1943
Place of Birth: East Stroudsburg, Pennsylvania, U.S.
Date of Death: Given as ‘May 2025’ by the Philadephia Inquirer. (https://www.inquirer.com/news/olney-raid-missing-women-mystery-drugs-20260627.html)
Place of Death: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

I am an independent journalist conducting research into the life of Raymond Charles Horsch. This request is made as part of news gathering and not for commercial use.

I request a waiver of all fees for this request. Disclosure of the requested information to me is in the public interest because it is likely to contribute significantly to public understanding of the operations or activities of the government and is not primarily in my commercial interest. 

The time period relevant to my research is quite broad; there may be documents concerning Horsch as early as 1960 and as late as his death in 2025. Horsch claimed to have encountered CIA officials as an employee of the Wackenhut Corporation in the early 1960s. He was employed by Wackenhut Corporation starting around 1963.

I am especially interested in any documents concerning:
- Horsch’s relationship with Philadelphia mob associate Salvatore “Sam the Barber” La Russa. La Russa financed Horsch’s pornographic film The Erotic Memoirs of a Male Chauvinist Pig in 1973.
- The 1974 arrest of Horsch for manufacturing counterfeit currency in Hatboro, Pennsylvania and the 1974 Secret Service raid of his home in Chalfont, Pennsylvania.
- Horsch’s arrest for manufacturing methamphetamine in 1977.
- Horsch’s life in New Zealand living under the assumed identity Stanley E. Stokowski starting in 1977.
- Any contact with CIA officers during his employment by Wackenhut.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Oscar Cozza

title: Henderson NV - Data sharing with LexisNexis

communications.subject: Nevada Public Records Act Request: Henderson NV - Data sharing with LexisNexis
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Nevada Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

All contracts, order forms, statements of work, quotes, and invoices between the City of Henderson and LexisNexis Risk Solutions (including LexisNexis Coplogic Solutions) for Lumen, Accurint for Law Enforcement, Accurint Virtual Crime Center (AVCC), Community Crime Map, Accurint Crime Analysis, or the Public Safety Data Exchange, including any AVCC XML Addendum or other data-sharing addendum, from January 1, 2019 to the present.

If you have more than four invoices, please just include the most recent four invoices.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
